## Basics

This tutorial and practical session focuses on learning the foundations of linux coding and using it on a HPC.

## Structure

We prefer to allow people to work at a pace that they are comfortable with rather than ensuring that everyone is at the same point of the tutorial at the same time. There will be no instructor telling you what to type and click. Instead, everything you require to carry out the practical is written in this document. Take your time; it's important to spend some time understanding why you are running the commands, rather than simply typing them out. 

If at any point you are having trouble or have a question, let one of us know and we'll provide 1-to-1 assistance.

## Content
![](/images/sections.png){style="width:100px; border-radius:5px; background-color:white; border: solid white 5px" fig-align="center"}

This practical is broken up into the following parts.

1. __[Intro](/index.qmd):__ Introduction and learning outcomes
2. __[Overview](/overview/linux_introduction.qmd):__ A quick overview of linux and the course structure
3. Part 1
    - __[Starting](/part_1/starting.qmd):__ Logging into our webVNC, and an introduction to the temrinal window & commands
    - __[Directories and files](/part_1/directories_and_files.qmd):__ Understanding and navigating directories and files
    - __[Tips and tricks](/part_1/tips_and_tricks.qmd):__ Useful Linux tips including tab completion and ending a command
    - __[Manipulating directories](/part_1/manipulating_directories.qmd):__ Making, moving, copying, and deleting directories and file
    - __[Exercise 1](/part_1/exercise1.qmd):__ Four tasks to reinforce learning
4. Part 2
    - __[File reading and processing](/part_2/file_reading_and_processing.qmd):__ Printing, viewing, pattern matching, and editing of files
    - __[Recap](/part_2/recap.qmd):__ A recap on all the concepts you have learnt
    - __[Fastq format](/part_2/fastq.qmd):__ Description of the fastq file format
    - __[Exercise 2](/part_2/exercise2.qmd):__ Eleven tasks involving the investigation and manipulation of fastq files
5. Advanced
    - __[Advanced Linux practice](/advanced/advanced_linux_practice.qmd):__ Wild card characters, redirection, pipe, regular expressions, sed, and permissions
    - __[Advanced practice exercise](/advanced/advanced_practice_exercise.qmd):__ Ten tasks utilising the advanced linux topics
    - __[Bioinformatic languages](/advanced/bioinformatic_languages.qmd):__ Brief intros to `awk`, Python, Perl, and R
6. Appendix
    - __[NEOF](/appendix/neof.qmd):__ Links to various NEOF resources
    - __[Cheat sheet](/appendix/cheat_sheet.qmd):__ Course cheat sheet
    - __[On your computer](/appendix/on_your_pc.qmd):__ Guidance on using a HPC and linux with your own pc
    - __[Mamba](/appendix/mamba.qmd):__ Information and links for mamba, a tool to more easily install bioinformatic tools/programs
    - __[Vim](/appendix/vim.qmd):__ A more advanced/complicated text editor than `nano`
    - __[FAQ](/appendix/faq.qmd):__ Answers to frequently asked questions
